description: Bit depth reducer and sample rate decimator, polyphonic, with the depth reducer's output normalled to the decimator's input

params.text: Sets the depth the signal is quantised to, 1 to 16 bits across a 10V range
Sets how many samples are held before a new one is taken, none at the bottom of its travel and 100 at the top, despite the panel printing BIT CRUSH

inputs.text: The signal to be quantised, clamped to the range -5V to 5V; its channel count sets the polyphony of both halves
Takes two bits off the depth setting for every volt
The signal to be decimated; with nothing patched here it takes the output of the bit depth reducer
Adds ten held samples per volt to the decimation setting
